rationale.risk-routing: Edit-likelihood thresholds select which generated tokens receive human attention.
rationale.ai-review: A separate probabilistic edit model judges likely-problematic generated tokens.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Standing highlights help programmers interpret and judge AI completions.

rationale.survey-input: Reports substantive programmer preferences for uncertainty-highlight designs.
